items.title: Sales API (DeveloperStore)
items.description: Complete CRUD API for sales records with quantity-based discounts, as defined in the README use case.

items.title: Discount policy matrix
items.description: Replace the hardcoded README discount rules with immutable, scoped, time-bound discount policies managed via API, and expose POST /api/sales/quote that applies them.

items.title: Sale lifecycle
items.description: Add the discount snapshots and the Open/Closed/Cancelled state rules to the sales persisted by FEAT-010 (spec 2).

items.title: Sale read model in MongoDB
items.description: Project sales, including the discount snapshot fields, into a MongoDB read model (spec 2).

items.title: Sale events
items.description: Publish SaleCreated, SaleModified, SaleCancelled, and ItemCancelled to the application log; no message broker required.

items.title: Sale drafts
items.description: Manage drafts separately from confirmed sales, moving them out of the transactional database under significant order growth; discounts are re-applied on confirmation (spec E1).

items.title: Asynchronous sale intake
items.description: Validate synchronously, enqueue via Rebus, and respond 202 Accepted with a status resource; transport, idempotency key, and retry/dead-letter are open points (spec E2).

items.title: Discount policy approval workflow
items.description: Add PendingApproval, Approved, and Rejected statuses to policies; the resolver considers only approved policies (spec E4).

items.title: Discount policy cache
items.description: Cache policies in IMemoryCache keyed by scope, invalidated on write, with cross-instance staleness bounded by a TTL (spec E6).

items.title: Partial invoicing per sale line
items.description: Allow several invoices per sale item with invoiced quantity locked; the discount impact (freeze the percentage or forbid reducing quantity) is still undecided (spec E7).

items.title: Registry CRUDs
items.description: CRUD APIs for customers, branches, products, and sales (sales as a plain registry without discount rules), following the Users template; implemented before FEAT-001.

items.title: List filtering and ordering
items.description: Add the general-api.md field filters, * wildcards, _min/_max ranges, and _order to the customer, branch, product, and sale list endpoints.

items.title: Customer document (CPF/CNPJ)
items.description: Add a required, unique Document field to customers that holds a CPF or a CNPJ, stored as digits only, with the type inferred from the length (11 digits = CPF, 14 = CNPJ) and validated through new CPF and CNPJ validator classes (length and check digits). Expose it through the customer create, update, get, and list endpoints. The migration deletes all existing customers before adding the column.

items.title: Branches, design-time factory fix, snapshot drift migration
items.description: Create the feature branch from dev, point the design-time DbContext factory at the ORM migrations assembly, and migrate the Users timestamp drift. Cancelled: the factory fix and migration moved to FEAT-010 (discount spec A12).

items.title: DiscountTier, DiscountDecision, InvalidStateException
items.description: Value objects for tiers and evaluation results, plus the exception that maps to 409.

items.title: DiscountPolicy aggregate
items.description: Aggregate with Create, Close, CanBeDeleted, IsInEffectAt, and Evaluate, enforcing its invariants.

items.title: Repository contract and DiscountPolicyResolver
items.description: IDiscountPolicyRepository and the domain service that picks the most specific policy per product.

items.title: Sale and SaleItem with ApplyDiscounts
items.description: In-memory Sale and SaleItem that evaluate per-product totals and store the discount snapshot on each line.

items.title: Persistence: mapping, seed migration, repository, integration tests
items.description: EF Core mapping for policies and tiers, seed migration with the README default policy, the repository, and PostgreSQL integration tests.

items.title: Error handling middleware and business error codes
items.description: Replace ValidationExceptionMiddleware with a middleware that maps failures to 400/404/409/422 in the general-api.md error format.

items.title: Create discount policy
items.description: POST /api/discount-policies through Application and API layers, plus the functional test infrastructure.

items.title: Get and list discount policies
items.description: GET by id and a paginated, filtered, ordered list of discount policies.

items.title: Sale discount rules and POST /api/sales/quote
items.description: Sale validators (QuantityLimitExceeded, DiscountAboveAllowed, NoDiscountPolicy) and the stateless quote endpoint.

items.title: Close and delete discount policies
items.description: POST /api/discount-policies/{id}/close and DELETE /api/discount-policies/{id} with their lifecycle rules.

items.title: Full verification
items.description: Clean build, full test suite, no pending model changes, and one commit per task.

items.title: Worktree, design-time factory fix, snapshot drift migration
items.description: Create the feature worktree, point the design-time DbContext factory at the ORM migrations assembly, and migrate the Users timestamp drift.

items.title: Customer, Branch, and Product entities
items.description: Customer, Branch, and Product entities with validators and happy-path tests.

items.title: Sale and SaleItem entities with SyncItems
items.description: Sale and SaleItem entities, validators, and SyncItems (add, update, remove items by id) with tests.

items.title: Persistence: repositories, mappings, sequence, migration
items.description: Repository contracts and EF Core implementations, mappings without external foreign keys, the SaleNumbers sequence, and the AddRegistryCruds migration.

items.title: Template fixes: 404, BUG-004, BUG-006
items.description: Map KeyNotFoundException to 404, remove BaseController.Ok<T> (BUG-004), and add the missing login mappings (BUG-006).

items.title: Customers API
items.description: Customer CRUD use cases, controller, and handler tests.

items.title: Branches API
items.description: Branch CRUD use cases, controller, and handler tests.

items.title: Products API
items.description: Product CRUD use cases, controller, and handler tests.

items.title: Sales API: create, get, list
items.description: Create, get, and list sales with catalog copies, TimeProvider registration, and handler tests.

items.title: Sales API: update and delete
items.description: Update sales by item id with copy refresh rules, delete sales, and handler tests.

items.title: Full verification and manual smoke test
items.description: Clean build, full unit suite, no pending model changes, and the manual smoke test against PostgreSQL.

items.title: Database-level discount policy overlap protection
items.description: PostgreSQL exclusion constraint on tstzrange(ValidFrom, ValidTo) per scope (btree_gist, COALESCE on nullable scope columns) to close the concurrent-create race (spec E5).

items.title: Npgsql-compatible default connection string
items.description: DefaultConnection in WebApi appsettings.json is SQL Server-shaped while the provider is Npgsql, and the compose WebApi service receives no connection string.

items.title: Register user validators in DI
items.description: No User validators are registered in DI, so ValidationBehavior is a no-op for them and validation runs only where validators are instantiated manually (spec A7).

items.title: Remove duplicate service registrations
items.description: AddControllers and AddHealthChecks are registered both in Program and in WebApiModuleInitializer.

items.title: Clean up docker-compose.yml
items.description: The ${APPDATA} volume mounts work only on Windows, and the Redis service carries MONGO_INITDB environment variables copied from the Mongo service.

items.title: Explicit transactions for write commands
items.description: Every CRUD write must open and close an explicit transaction: a MediatR TransactionBehavior over an IUnitOfWork, applied to commands marked ITransactionalCommand. Until then each write relies on a single SaveChangesAsync (registry CRUDs D7).

items.title: Registry CRUD unit tests beyond the happy path
items.description: Add error-path and validation-boundary tests and Bogus TestData generators for the customer, branch, product, and sale CRUDs, plus WebApi tests (Unit project reference to WebApi) for the BUG-004 fix and the 404 middleware mapping (registry CRUDs D14).

items.title: Upgrade AutoMapper past the known vulnerability
items.description: The build reports NU1903: AutoMapper 13.0.1 has a known high-severity vulnerability (GHSA-rvv3-g6hj-g44x) in the Application and WebApi projects.

items.title: Remove duplicate CreateUser request mapping
items.description: CreateUserRequest to CreateUserCommand is mapped both in WebApi/Mappings/CreateUserRequestProfile and in Features/Users/CreateUser/CreateUserProfile; AutoMapper silently keeps one of them.

items.title: Stable sale item order
items.description: SaleRepository.GetByIdAsync includes items without ordering, so GET returns sale lines in database order, which can differ from the POST response.

items.title: GetCurrentUserId parses a Guid user id as int
items.description: BaseController.GetCurrentUserId calls int.Parse on the NameIdentifier claim, which holds a Guid, so it throws on first use; there is no caller yet.

items.title: Invalid login returns 500
items.description: AuthenticateUserHandler throws UnauthorizedAccessException, which no middleware maps (also after TASK-007); expected 401.

items.title: Duplicate e-mail on user creation returns 500
items.description: CreateUserHandler throws InvalidOperationException for an existing e-mail, which no middleware maps; expected a 4xx response.

items.title: BaseController.Ok<T> wraps every Ok response twice
items.description: BaseController.Ok<T>(T) shadows ControllerBase.Ok(object), so Users GET/DELETE, Auth login, and OkPaginated return a doubly wrapped body; fixed in FEAT-010 by removing the method.

items.title: GET /api/users/{id} returns 500
items.description: UsersController maps GetUserResult to GetUserResponse, but no AutoMapper profile defines that map, so AutoMapperMappingException becomes a 500. The User to GetUserResult map also left Name empty, since the entity property is Username; fixed with it.

items.title: Login returns 500 because of missing mappings
items.description: AuthController maps AuthenticateUserRequest to AuthenticateUserCommand and AuthenticateUserResult to AuthenticateUserResponse, but no profile defines them; fixed in FEAT-010 so write endpoints can get a token.

items.title: Null sale item returns 500
items.description: A null element in items passes the sale validators (ChildRules skips nulls) and fails with NullReferenceException; expected 400. Add RuleForEach(Items).NotNull() and make the duplicate-id rule null-safe.

items.title: Huge _page overflows the list offset
items.description: (page - 1) * size overflows int for very large _page; Postgres rejects the negative OFFSET and the list returns 500 instead of an empty page.

items.title: Money values with more than two decimals are silently rounded
items.description: Unit price, amounts, and DiscountPercentage are not validated against numeric(18,2)/numeric(5,2): extra decimals are echoed in the response but stored rounded, tiny values fail CHECK constraints with 500, and huge values overflow. Add PrecisionScale rules.

items.title: POST /api/users echoes empty user fields
items.description: CreateUserResult has only Id, so the CreateUserResult to CreateUserResponse map leaves name, email, and phone empty and role and status at 0 in the 201 response, even though the user is stored with the values sent.
